payments_reconcile_idx.name: payments_reconcile_idx
payments_reconcile_idx.where: status = 'PENDING' AND provider_payment_id IS NOT NULL

subscription_operations_amount_check.name: subscription_operations_amount_check
subscription_operations_amount_check.value:
(
      ("payments"."subscription_operations"."kind" = 'RETRY' and "payments"."subscription_operations"."provider_payment_id" is not null and "payments"."subscription_operations"."amount_in_cents" is not null and "payments"."subscription_operations"."amount_in_cents" > 0)
    or ("payments"."subscription_operations"."kind" <> 'RETRY' and "payments"."subscription_operations"."provider_payment_id" is null and "payments"."subscription_operations"."amount_in_cents" is null)
  )

subscription_recovery_policy_check.name: subscription_recovery_policy_check
subscription_recovery_policy_check.value: "payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."policy" ? 'version' and "payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."policy" ? 'windowDays' and "payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."policy" ? 'reminderDays' and jsonb_typeof("payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."policy"->'version') = 'number' and jsonb_typeof("payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."policy"->'windowDays') = 'number' and ("payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."policy"->>'version')::integer > 0 and ("payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."policy"->>'windowDays')::integer between 1 and 30 and jsonb_typeof("payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."policy"->'reminderDays') = 'array'

subscription_recovery_notice_check.name: subscription_recovery_notice_check
subscription_recovery_notice_check.value:
(
    ("payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."initial_notice_id" is null and "payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."initial_notice_accepted_at" is null and "payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."deadline_at" is null)
    or ("payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."initial_notice_id" is not null and "payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."initial_notice_accepted_at" is not null and "payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."deadline_at" is not null
      and "payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."initial_notice_accepted_at" >= "payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."opened_at"
      and "payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."deadline_at" = "payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."initial_notice_accepted_at" + (("payments"."subscription_recovery_cases"."policy"->>'windowDays')::integer * interval '86400 seconds'))
  )

subscription_recovery_notices_attempt_ch.name: subscription_recovery_notices_attempt_check
subscription_recovery_notices_attempt_ch.value: "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."attempt_count" >= 0 and (("payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."attempt_count" = 0 and "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."last_attempt_at" is null) or ("payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."attempt_count" > 0 and "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."last_attempt_at" is not null and "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."last_attempt_at" >= "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."created_at"))

subscription_recovery_notices_receipt_ch.name: subscription_recovery_notices_receipt_check
subscription_recovery_notices_receipt_ch.value: ("payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."message_id" is null and "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."message_status" is null and "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."accepted_at" is null and "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."delivered_at" is null and "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."observed_at" is null) or ("payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."message_id" is not null and "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."message_status" is not null and "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."accepted_at" is not null and "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."observed_at" is not null and "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."accepted_at" >= "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."created_at" and "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."observed_at" >= "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."accepted_at" and ("payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."delivered_at" is null or "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."delivered_at" between "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."accepted_at" and "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."observed_at"))

subscription_recovery_notices_delivery_c.name: subscription_recovery_notices_delivery_check
subscription_recovery_notices_delivery_c.value: "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."message_status" is null or "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."message_status" not in ('DELIVERED', 'READ') or "payments"."subscription_recovery_notices"."delivered_at" is not null

subscriptions_reconcile_idx.name: subscriptions_reconcile_idx
subscriptions_reconcile_idx.where: status = 'ACTIVE' AND provider_subscription_id IS NOT NULL
